about.name: Andrei Tolstykh
about.subtitle: Senior Product Designer
paragraphs: I'm a Product and UI/UX Designer with 7+ years of experience designing complex B2B products across Big Tech and startup environments. Currently, I work at an AI startup, where I design a platform for trustworthy and responsible AI. Previously, I worked at one of Eastern Europe's largest FinTech companies, designing a large-scale financial platform and contributing to SAP-based enterprise solutions.

I specialize in simplifying complex workflows and creating scalable product experiences. I collaborate closely with engineers and product teams and have built two large-scale design systems in Storybook.
Using AI-powered CLI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, I develop and maintain these systems and turn their components into functional, high-fidelity prototypes.

experience.description: Lead product design for an enterprise AI platform, simplifying complex evaluation workflows and data-heavy experiences. Built two large-scale design systems in Storybook and use AI-powered CLI tools to turn production components into functional, high-fidelity prototypes.

Designed a large-scale enterprise FinTech platform, simplifying fragmented financial workflows across 100+ internal services. Worked end-to-end from discovery and research to responsive web and mobile delivery.
Promoted division products via presentations, video content, and training materials.

projects.name: QuantPi Platform
projects.description: Full-cycle UX/UI for an AI testing system used by 5+ Enterprise clients. Built 10+ AI evaluation modules and model pipelines across 3 core services.

projects.name: AI Hub
projects.description: Design of an enterprise AI governance platform for evaluating LLM systems against regulatory and trust frameworks. Designed Trust Profiles, risk matrices, and automated assessment workflows.
